name: Panda Gaming Desktop v1.1.0
body:
Panda Gaming Desktop desktop installers.

Added scrcpy diagnostic logging to help troubleshoot mirroring startup failures.
Mirroring errors now show the exit status and recent log output.
Added a Copy log button to easily share diagnostic details with support.

adb, scrcpy and scrcpy-server are included. No separate installation is required.

name: Panda Gaming Desktop v1.0.0
body:
Panda Gaming Desktop desktop installers.

- Fixed wireless device detection for ADB identifiers containing spaces or parentheses.
- Added automatic saving and restoration of mirroring settings, including resolution, frame rate, bitrate, audio, and display options.
- Added Windows ARM64 development support using bundled x64 adb and scrcpy tools through Windows 11 emulation.

adb and scrcpy are included—no separate installation is required.

name: Panda Gaming Desktop v0.1.6
body:
## What’s Changed

- Fixed an issue where the mirroring window failed to open on some Windows systems.
- Fixed `scrcpy-server` path handling on Windows.

Thanks to everyone who helped test and diagnose this issue!
